# AutoloadingIssues

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> 

Group: [Probable bugs](/rules/#probable-bugs) · PhpStorm name: `AutoloadingIssuesInspection`

PSR-0/PSR-4 autoloaders locate a class by its name, so a file that declares a
single class whose name does not match the file name will not be found by the
autoloader. Point at the class name when file and class names disagree.

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "AutoloadingIssues": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore AutoloadingIssues

/**
 * @noinspection AutoloadingIssuesInspection
 */
```
